ZIP Code Map Maker

LA & Orange County, 390 ZIP areas

1Your data

Drop a CSV or JSON file here
or click to choose a file. It needs a ZIP code column or field.
Census Reporter GeoJSON files work too.
Your file stays on your computer. Nothing is uploaded.
Loaded

2Titles & labels

3Colors

Fill strength

4Map & layout

Saved maps open with your data and style. Keep editing and save again any time.
